name: Cyrus Cole
life: Cyrus took up fishkeeping during a miserable year of night payroll. The little routines gave him one piece of a day he could predict. He will rearrange a whole week's plans for an animal that needs food dropped on a particular side. On Friday, near Studio Boulevard, Cyrus waits by the window where the whole crossing can be seen without leaning into the road.
voice: One fish has a crooked jaw. It needs its food dropped on the left. I took the difficult one, then learned separating the pair made both stop eating.
appearance: Cyrus has a narrow face with an expressive upper lip. Look for short copper curls. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a faded indigo overshirt with a pen clipped inside the neckline. In conversation Cyrus leans a shoulder against the wall during long conversations.
personality: Cyrus tells a better story in a kitchen than at a microphone. Family members sometimes underestimate how far Cyrus will go to back a quiet opinion once it is actually challenged.
agenda: To bring the two fish back into the same working tank.
family: Aubrey Farah is Cyrus’s older relative by marriage. Cyrus picks the meeting place. Aubrey sets the time to leave. It lets them stay close without turning a family visit into the loss of an entire day. They have both had stretches when that distinction mattered. Asked about *Laundry for a stranger*, Aubrey says, “I accused my carer of mixing up the bags. I am taking the apology to her home on foot.”
connections: Mo Gill. They try the shop's spare pump on the two fish whose feeding habits only one of them really knows.

reactions.situation: A reporter asks which neighbor held the aquarium key
reactions.response: Cyrus asks whether the tenant wants the key holder named before saying anything to the reporter.

reactions.situation: An argument on the pavement makes a bystander feel unsafe
reactions.response: Cyrus puts distance between the frightened person and the argument and asks nearby staff for help.

reactions.situation: If a relative makes a joke at a child's expense
reactions.response: Cyrus repeats the child's actual point and waits for a reply to that.
